body.text: Independent review: a current rights-aware replay of the representative $579 lease-takeover page returned HTTP 200, robots allow, a hash-matching retained body, and both price and lease-takeover text. However, all 31 Craigslist receipts that feed the claimed corpus lack observe_right, policy_decision, fetch_attempted, and robots fields. The normalizer accepts a hash-valid legacy source_observed receipt without those fields; an isolated adversarial replay emitted a candidate. The corpus is byte-bound but its claimed robots/rights discipline is not proven. Require policy-allow evidence for new projections, or classify legacy rows as provenance-unknown until reobserved.

subject: Review: housing-social replay passes, but legacy receipt provenance is policy-unbound
